svg.title: X posts about TikTok and peptides jumped on October 20
svg.desc: English posts on X mentioning TikTok with peptides, by UTC day: 6, 6, 10, 6, 11 and 13 from October 14 to 19, 2026, then 320 on October 20 through 6:01 PM ET, after a post late on October 19 said TikTok searches for BPC-157 and melanotan returned no results.
